title: Audit Chips filter visual depth
description: Audit Chips for pill anatomy, icons, removable/active states, counts, overflow, wrapping, multi-select behavior, and field binding.
objective: Make Chips a polished visual option pattern rather than a renamed checkbox group.
acceptance_criteria: The audit identifies how Chips differ from Checkbox in markup, semantics, and controls.
The audit covers icons, counts, gap, radius, padding, active/hover/focus states, and long label behavior.
The audit checks whether chips can be configured as single-select or multi-select if needed.
The audit ties chip values to option parsing and field binding.
verification: Source-backed findings cite render, CSS, JS, and control IDs.
No Chips implementation is made by this task.

budgets.context_budget: chips audit, render, CSS, option parsing

risks: Chips can become attractive but inaccessible if native input semantics are hidden without a clear interaction model.
